milestone: SeLinOS immutable VFS M9 exact Linux version bridge

contract.archive: The generated newc archive contains exactly one added regular member `/selinos-version` with the fixed eight-byte payload `SELINOS9`.
contract.romfs: romfsd self-checks and exposes the record through fixed selector 4 and fixed FD 6; packed pathname routing remains capped at 16 printable bytes.
contract.linux_bridge: The isolated Linux probe proves exact `openat(AT_FDCWD, /selinos-version, 0, 0) -> 6`, `read(6, mapped_one_page, 8) -> 8`, payload `SELINOS9`, then `close(6) -> 0`.
contract.negative_scope: No arbitrary pathname, directory enumeration, metadata, seek, persistent write, multi-page stream, dynamic FD allocation or POSIX filesystem semantics are provided.

required_markers: SeLinOS ABI M9: exact immutable /selinos-version open/read/close bridge mediated.
SeLinOS romfsd: immutable release and version records service online.
SeLinOS romfsd: embedded newc CPIO multi-file parser ready.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS ABI gateway: restricted version openat rejected.
SeLinOS ABI gateway: restricted version read rejected.
SeLinOS ABI gateway: restricted version close rejected.

not_claimed: arbitrary pathname or dynamic file descriptor support
directories, metadata, symlinks, permissions or POSIX filesystem semantics
seek/cursor semantics, arbitrary offsets, partial or multi-page stream I/O
persistent writes, package state database, package extraction or maintainer scripts
TLS, dynamic linker, general Linux user-space ABI, dpkg or apt
